title: A field prop model: data/field_prop_models/<exterior|interior>/<bundle>/<model>/data.json
description: A model of a field prop bundle (archives a/2/2/5 and a/2/2/6), whose geometry and materials are model.glb next to this file. A bundle is named after its constant in data/constants/field_props_exterior.txt or field_props_interior.txt, and a model after its own name, numbered where it repeats in the bundle. tools/data/field_prop_model_data.py packs them.

res_id.description: The prop's resource ID, which the map models' prop placements (bw2_prop_NNNN_id_XXXXX) name. It is the bundle's and can't be changed here

transformed.description: Set when the GLB's positions went through the model's node transforms on export, which the packer reverses

positions.description: For a transformed model whose transforms the packer can't yet work out from the GLB's joints, its vertices' positions as exported

glb_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of model.glb as extracted. A GLB that still has it packs the original model unchanged, since not every unedited model survives conversion; an edited one is converted
